thread:
maria: quick thought — when someone switches the model in a per-route view, can we show an inline cost/latency delta next to the filter chips? would help folks pick cheaper variants before they run queries

derek: agree. current dropdown feels too detached. maybe a small badge like `+12ms / +0.3¢` next to model name? :money_with_wings:

faiza: we also need to consider sampling/telemetry skew — showing a naive per-token cost from the model catalog will be misleading unless we include sample-length assumptions

product-ux: good point. proposed UX: hover tooltip on the badge that shows assumptions (seq len, batching, sample-rate). quick sketch: `Model: redwood-7b  +8ms  +0.2¢  (assumes seq=256, batch=1, sampling=1.0)`

eng-console: for implementation, we could add a `cost_preview` field to the route inspector API that returns {model_id, delta_latency_ms, delta_cost_per_token, assumptions}. consumers can render the badge + tooltip.

maria: can we standardize the assumptions key names? product wants to support per-team overrides (e.g., enterprise using batching 4).

faiza: API contract suggestion in chat (quick):
```json
GET /api/v1/routes/{route_id}/cost_preview?models=[a,b]
Response: {"base_model": "redwood-13b", "previews": [{"model": "redwood-7b","delta_latency_ms": -10,"delta_cost_per_token": -0.45,"assumptions": {"seq_len": 128,"batch_size":1,"sample_rate":1.0}}]}
```

product-ux: love that. UX followups: 1) small-state: show badge for non-zero deltas only, 2) expand mode: inline modal that lists preview across all pinned models for the route, 3) saved-query note: when you save a query, capture the cost_preview snapshot so we can surface regressions on rollouts

derek: flag: saved-query snapshots must be cheap to compute. don't want to call model perf profiler on every save. maybe compute on save for user-visible models, otherwise fallback to cached catalog metrics.

eng-console: agreed. backend plan: compute from cached per-model perf profile + route telemetry histogram (seq len distribution). if customer overrides batching, apply override multiplier. queue background recompute after save and mark snapshot as `estimated` until recompute completes.

maria: question — how do we show effect of rate limits / quotas? someone might pick a model that hits Dedicated capacity and spikes latency even if token cost is low

faiza: suggest adding a "quota-risk" flag in preview: values NONE / POSSIBLE / LIKELY with short rationale (e.g., "limited capacity in us-west") — UI can show a warning icon with reason on hover

product-ux: UX nit: warning text should be actionable: "May be capacity-constrained for burst > 200 rps — consider Dedicated or fallback policy". also we need a tiny CTA to open routing policy editor from the modal.

eng-console: deploy-bot: deploy-preview built for cost_preview API to staging at https://staging-console.redwood.internal/ — expect schema v0.1.2.

deploy-bot: ✅ deployment succeeded (staging, cost_preview v0.1.2) — route inspector changes behind feature flag `route_cost_preview`

maria: awesome. next steps: faiza + eng-console to finalize API shape, product-ux to wire mockups, derek to check saved-query snapshot cadence constraints

faiza: I'll draft a tiny ADR for `cost_preview` assumptions and the `snapshot` lifecycle by EOD tomorrow.

maria: perfect — thanks all :rocket:
